EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THEEHELIYAGODA PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member in Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Termination of PartyMembership ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Socialist Party of Sri Lanka, the recognized political party to whichKelaniyage Ratnapala the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1) of the aforesaid ordinance, todecide upon returned member if Socialist Party of Sri Lanka who belongs to such party and is not disqualified underSection 9 of the local authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period ofthirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party, has communicated his decision tonominate Wathawana Vithana Wasam Pemachandra to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Suranga Ambagahathenne, Returning Officer of the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha,acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatWathawana Vithana Wasam Pemachandra was Selected as the member of the Eheliyagoda Pradeshiya Sabha.
